parts:
Hi,

I am new to unmarked and I am struggling while doing analysis with covariates for gamma and omega.

I have developed simple models with dynamics=constant. This way I have an option of exploring whether high temperature, heavy snowfall have an effect on recruitment rate (gamma) and survival (omega) respectively.

Summary of data: I have 8 years of bird count data across defined transects. 8 years of snowfall and temperature data (yearlysite covariates). Dates of survey (observation covariates). Habitat and fragmentation indices (site covariates)

My one model looks something like below. But it seems like it's never going to finish running.  Isn't this how I am not supposed to use yearlysite covariates?
 pcountOpen(~grass,~max_survey,~snow_survey,~dates_survey, estabun_open, K=250, dynamics = "constant",mixture = "P") 


Thanks in advance for any help,

Leo
